text:
maria: Heads-up — canary rollout showing a perf regression after the last autotune merge. Canary pool A started spiking compile jobs; nodes hit sustained compile loops. CI perf job failed with p95 +80%. @sam @jia
sam: ugh, got any repro logs or a short summary?
maria: quick excerpt from the canary runtime logs (trimmed):
```
[2026-03-18T12:45:10Z] autotuner: chosen_kernel=quant_slow_v2 tie_score=0.42 prev_best=quant_fast_v1 score=0.42
[2026-03-18T12:45:11Z] compile_queue: enqueue kernel_compile id=0x7a3
[2026-03-18T12:45:11Z] kvcache: invalidation: key_prefix=/kvcache/prefix/ job=prefix_reset
[2026-03-18T12:45:13Z] autotuner: recompiling candidate because cache_miss_count>3
```
maria: CI link: https://ci.redwood/internal/789 (perf/regression alert)
jia: that looks like the tie-breaker heuristic change in PR #4321 — autotune now biases "lower memory" when scores are equal. For a lot of small-batch traffic that ties frequently, it flips kernels which causes different kernel+config combos to be compiled and evicts/kicks KV cache. Cascade -> compile storm -> latency spike.
sam: can we flip the flag to old behaviour quickly, or set AUTOTUNE_TIEBREAK=prefer_prev?
ryan: CI job 789 shows the same spike across 3 nodes. Rolling revert seems safest for canary. I'll open a rollback PR.
maria: starting revert to canary now, pushing hotfix.
perf-bot: [alert] canary-perf/regression p95 +83% (started 1987654310)
jia: short-term patch idea: add deterministic tie-breaker that prefers previous picked kernel if score within epsilon, and bias tie by seq_len histogram. That prevents oscillation across micro-batches. Also add a KV cache key stability test.
sam: agreed. I'll run a bisect on recent merges to confirm 4321 is the root cause and produce a minimal repro.
maria: created issue #9876 with logs, sample trace and bisect TODO. Tagging eng-runtime and eng-oncall.
ryan: after revert, add unit/integration test to CI: simulate frequent equal-score picks and assert no compile churn > N per minute.
maria: deploying revert to all canaries, monitoring. Will post updated perf numbers in 10m. :thumbsup:
sam: thanks — if bisect pins 4321, we'll craft a smaller PR with deterministic tie-break and KV key invariants.
maria: update: revert rolled, p95 returned to baseline on canary after 7m. Keeping monitoring and will follow up in the issue with bisect output.
ryan: nice. also add a changelog note so future autotune patches mention tie-break semantics.
maria: done
